name: CheXBench
intro: CheXBench是用于评估胸部X光图像理解的综合基准，涵盖图像感知、图像-文本推理和文本生成等八种不同任务类型，旨在推动胸部X光AI模型的开发和临床应用。
org: Stanford Center for Artificial Intelligence in Medicine and Imaging
build_method: 定义 35 项任务的五类 taxonomy：粗粒度图像感知、细粒度图像感知、文本生成、问答和其他；对 32 个公开数据集做工程化处理，保留官方划分并整合八类评测任务
metric: Accuracy, mIoU/mAP, CheXbert-F1, BERTScore, RadGraph-F1, ROUGE-L
task_type: 多选题, 问答, 文本生成
eval_feature: 胸部X光图像理解, 图像-文本推理, 文本生成，八种任务类型
scale: 三条评测轴, 八类任务；训练背景含32个公开数据集与850万条CheXinstruct三元组
build_method_en: Define 35 tasks in five categories—coarse-grained image perception, fine-grained image perception, text generation, question answering, and miscellaneous—then engineer 32 public datasets, preserve official splits, and integrate eight evaluation task types
eval_feature_en: chest X-ray image understanding, image-text reasoning, text generation, eight task types
intro_en: CheXBench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating chest X-ray image understanding, covering eight different task types including image perception, image-text reasoning, and text generation. It aims to advance the development and clinical application of chest X-ray AI models.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2401.12208v2, Methods: Description of the CheXinstruct dataset, Building CheXbench, and Setup of the Reader Study. Official CheXagent repository snapshot e4f31e6 and CheXbench dataset revision 97fc510 were inspected. The paper defines 35 tasks in five categories: coarse-grained image perception, fine-grained image perception, text generation, question answering, and miscellaneous. It gathers 32 public datasets with 1,077,494 unique images, applies manual quality control plus automated engineering, uses GPT-4 to restructure free-form reports, and preserves official or traditional train/validation/test splits. CheXinstruct contains exactly 8,466,352 triplets and samples instructions from ten manually written templates per task. Held-out CheXbench has three image-perception task types (600 view, 62 temporal, and 2,684 disease examples), three image-text-reasoning task types (380 fine-grained, 238 VQA, and 149 grounding examples), and two text-generation task types (2,451 findings-generation and 1,394 summarization examples). Metrics are accuracy, mIoU/mAP, CheXbert-F1, BERTScore, RadGraph-F1, and ROUGE-L as task-appropriate. CheXagent training is comparison context, not benchmark data. There is no separate radiologist expert-review stage for generated benchmark answers: the paper's distinct reader study instead has four residents and four attendings work on 50 MIMIC-CXR test cases, 30 per reader, measuring report time, indication applicability, edit reasons, and perceived efficiency.
